title: WRRA-M 0.12: Reviewed SI Energy and Pressure, Sequential Calibration and Proper-Time Mode Spectra
description:
Reviewed 0.10–0.12 series includes all three English and Korean papers. Frozen address/carrier inputs map to one SI energy and volume-derived pressure function. Five-anchor sequential calibration supplies the electron mass unit; worldline proper-time updates and finite boundary spectra are calculated. All 96 component check groups pass with unchanged inputs and numerical results.

The old slow expansion clock fails identification with the SI energy phase at frequency ratio 2.10e-43. This failure is retained in 0.10, 0.11 and 0.12. The shutter interval is a disclosed construction choice, not a measured minimum. Physical observation outcomes and records remain 0.13. Conservation, pressure differentiation, anchor isolation, Lorentz invariance and boundary/phase-branch consistency are falsifiers. Calibration and reproduction are legitimate achievements, with no requirement for numerical novelty or a unique universe solution.
